api.go: Existing preparation/guide public API and ADR0350: no signature, dependency-position or constructor change.
wire_test.go: Unchanged constructor-only binding to independent implementation; existing old recipient implementation supplies the feature red baseline.
help.txt: ADR0350 adds explicit arrangements to the same reviewed-save flow, leaving separate export and plan/record ownership unchanged.
arrangement-plan.yaml: Hand-authored schemaVersion1 plan with exact known directory IDs and both visible/inactive sections; ADR0350 requires all declared choices, not activation/default inference. Contact save is a deliberate literal menu-word fixture.
arrangements-before.yaml: ADR0190 scoped repair and ADR0350 full original review. Two arrangements deliberately have nonlexical ID order; unrelated stale recipient.manager and first arrangement.owner must survive. Selected second arrangement is otherwise valid with ordered nonadjacent repeated helpers, past calendar-valid goal and held multiline note. Unknown fictional privacy marker must be retained but not displayed.
arrangements-appended.yaml: Independent literal expected append from preparation editor contract SetArrangement, preserving original order/whole unrelated values. Preparation encoder contract specifies known field order, list order, quoted dates, multiline literal blocks, whitespace quoting and trailing unknown fields. Newly supplied helpers retain helper/manager/helper/save exactly.
arrangements-edited.yaml: Hand-specified whole replacement of a-edit at index1, keeping exact ID and first unrelated item. Optional owner/reference/target/note clears persist, status pending explicitly permits incomplete preparation, one selected helper occurrence is removed. No whole-file validity gate under0190.
arrangements-helper-removed.yaml: Explicit helper ordinal3 removes only the final helper from [helper,manager,helper], producing [helper,manager], not a set or first-match removal. All other modeled and unknown data remains held.
arrangements-helpers-cleared.yaml: 0350 explicit helper clear copies absence into local arrangement only, then enclosing apply stages whole arrangement. Explicitly changing arranged to pending allows incomplete helpers under existing validator; owner/reference/target/note remain unchanged. Independent literal encoder field omission and ordering.
arrangement-minimal.yaml: Independent literal expected schema1 identity plus explicitly named pending access preparation for declared inactive section. No inferred status/kind/contact/reference; optional absent fields omitted by existing encoder rules.
arrangement-and-recipient.yaml: 0340 and0350 share one accepted draft and single reviewed save. Name and one minimal arrangement are staged, never separate intermediate publications.
arrangements-removed.yaml: Actual editor RemoveArrangement semantics specified independently: remove exactly a-edit, retain stale first item/recipient/unknown data without readiness repair.
empty-contacts-noop.yaml: Existing decoder contract explicitly maps absent/null/empty contacts to nil. Comment and noncanonical key order with contacts:[] test original-byte/inode preservation after unchanged helper apply/back; this is not an invented stored distinction between nil and empty.
malformed-arrangement-id.yaml: 0190 and0350 permit removal of one explicitly selected unique malformed ID, without changing or guessing its identity. Serialized ID is quoted to preserve exact Bad ID text.
arrangement-review.txt: Hand-written exact original/draft full known-field blocks for edit-whole-arrangement-clears-in-place. Derived from frozen fixture facts and normative Q grammar, not from a product renderer. Includes absent scalars/lists, ordered repeated helpers, removed/cleared values and literal multiline display.
arrangement-cases.json: Each recipe cites0350,0190 or the specific existing dependency rule; exact saved bytes are the independent literal fixtures, not encoder-derived output.
arrangements_test.go: Protected public Run boundary with real files/streams. All original recipient/native ACL tests remain unchanged; new cases cover append, replacement, permanent identity, nested apply/back, staged removal, unknown/record preservation and safe scalar/full-list review. A full-count/nonnil output error specifically in the Draft arrangements block must leave queued save input unread and the staged removal unpublished; the failed writer's payload is not a product oracle.
budget_test.go: ADR0350 consumed-input budget and standard io.Reader data-plus-EOF behavior. Independently constructed byte-length padding uses valid <=64KiB logical lines, UTF-8 byte rather than rune accounting, LF/CRLF framing, exact-budget completed save, complete-action and mid-line exhaustion, unread EOF/cancel precedence, no additional Read call at cap, unchanged source bytes and unconsumed suffix. Output is discarded, not accumulated; no timing or peak-memory claim.
partial_input_test.go: 0340 valid UTF-8 logical line limit65536 excluding LF/CRLF and0350 total-budget precedence. Invalid partial UTF-8 (including incomplete code point) and oversized logical payload still refuse guide.input at EOF; a valid incomplete line below totalbudget cancels without action. A bare terminal CR is payload, not CRLF framing: 65535+CR validpartial, 65536+CR oversized, 65536+CRLF validcomplete. Every control runs with separate EOF and final bytes plus io.EOF. Expected status/code/filesystem are independent of both implementations; rejected partial personal-input markers must not be echoed.
resources_darwin_test.go: Existing owned-resource lifecycle rule made explicit: release owned inspection/publication handles before Run returns, retain caller-owned streams. Nonparallel test holds a hard-link anchor, not an opened descriptor, to prevent original inode freeing/reuse during observation; anchor must retain original identity bytes. Read-only names-only /dev/fd enumeration followed by Fstat counts only this unique device/inode, avoiding unrelated descriptors. Baseline holds none; after successful changed save exact literal named bytes and replacement inode remain but no owned handle may retain original inode. No descriptors discovered by the test are closed; only its own enumeration handle is closed. Native platform file excludes non-Darwin. Test is independent of product inspection implementation and uses only public constructor binding.
